en_title: GTA 6: All the Major New Details Revealed Today, Including Animal Species, Side Activities, and Fast Travel
subtitle: 地图大到离谱
opus_summary: Game Informer披露《GTA6》大量新情报：地图规模约为《GTA5》的两倍，包含六大区域和170种动物，并将加入飓风、动态天气、拼车快旅行、抢劫、狩猎与角色关系等系统。

paragraphs.en: Game Informer's GTA 6 coverage reveal has shed new light on Rockstar's upcoming game, and we've rounded up all the big new information.
paragraphs.cn: Game Informer对《GTA6》的报道揭示了Rockstar这款新作的更多信息，我们整理出了其中所有重要情报。

paragraphs.en: In the story, Rockstar shared new details about GTA 6's ambitious weather systems , the wildlife and NPCs that populate the world, and the scope of GTA 6's map.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar在报道中分享了《GTA6》雄心勃勃的天气系统、遍布世界各地的野生动物和NPC，以及游戏地图规模方面的新细节。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has managed to pull off one of the most speculated parts of GTA 6: hurricanes. Fans were hoping to see Florida's most significant weather event replicated in GTA 6, but given how intense hurricanes are, many wondered if it was even technically feasible. Speaking to Game Informer, Rockstar confirmed they will be featured in the game, but declined to share how often they will happen and if they will impact the story.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar成功实现了《GTA6》中最受玩家猜测的内容之一：飓风。玩家一直希望在游戏中看到佛罗里达州最具代表性的天气现象，但考虑到飓风的破坏力，许多人都曾怀疑这在技术上是否可行。Rockstar在接受Game Informer采访时确认，游戏中会出现飓风，但没有透露它们会多频繁发生，也没有说明是否会影响剧情。

paragraphs.en: As for how they will be depicted, fans can expect “heavy clouds, strong winds, dense atmospherics, and a lot of rain combine so that everything is dripping wet, water is gushing off roof edges and lampposts, thunder rumbles and flashes of lightning light up the clouds dramatically.”
paragraphs.cn: 至于飓风的呈现方式，玩家可以期待这样的景象：「厚重的云层、强劲的风、浓密的氛围效果和倾盆大雨交织在一起，让一切都湿淋淋的；水流从屋檐和路灯杆边缘倾泻而下，雷声轰鸣，闪电划破天空，将云层映照得格外壮观。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar's VP of art for lighting and rendering, Owen Shepherd, confirmed that the studio re-engineered its weather system to allow for localized, persistent, and dynamic weather. The player can soak up sunny rays in one part of the map, but still be able to see a rainstorm in the distance. The game will also feature rainbows and puddles, allowing the player to travel through an area and deduce that it recently rained there without having been present for it. Additionally, wind will create ripples in the water, blow hair around,
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar负责灯光与渲染美术的副总裁Owen Shepherd确认，工作室重新设计了天气系统，使其能够呈现局部、持续且动态变化的天气。玩家可以在地图某处享受阳光，同时看到远处正在下雨。游戏中还会出现彩虹和水洼，玩家即使没有亲眼见证降雨，也能在经过某个区域时从环境变化判断那里刚下过雨。此外，风还会在水面吹起涟漪，吹动角色的头发，

paragraphs.en: Rockstar North co-studio head Aaron Garbut confirmed that GTA 6's map is twice as big as GTA 5's, with an emphasis on density. The setting of the game, as many know, is a fictionalized version of Florida known as Leonida.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Aaron Garbut确认，《GTA6》的地图规模是《GTA5》的两倍，同时会着重提升内容密度。正如许多人所知，游戏舞台是以佛罗里达州为原型虚构出的莱昂尼达州。

paragraphs.en: "This new world is different," Garbut said. "We obsessed about every part – the rooftops, the alleys, the internals and everything in between to the point we hit a critical mass with the numbers of our interiors, and you start to feel the buildings are more real inside and out. This world is a cohesive whole with the density of content and a hand-crafted quality to every bit."
paragraphs.cn: Garbut说道：「这个新世界与众不同。我们仔细打磨了每个部分——屋顶、小巷、室内空间，以及其中的一切，直到室内场景的数量达到临界点，让你开始觉得建筑物内外都更加真实。这个世界是一个完整统一的整体，每个角落都拥有高密度的内容和手工打造的品质。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's map will feature six different regions. The most prominent one is Vice City, a location fans are familiar with thanks to 2002's GTA: Vice City. The other regions of Leonida include Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的地图将包含六个不同区域。其中最prominent的是罪恶都市，玩家通过2002年的《GTA：罪恶都市》早已对这里十分熟悉。莱昂尼达州的其他区域包括莱昂尼达群岛、Grassrivers、Port Gellhorn、Ambrosia和卡拉加山国家公园。

paragraphs.en: Ambrosia is a more rural part of the map with factories and refineries, dominated by a biker gang who control the area. This gang appears to be different from the Lost MC, which were prominently featured in GTA 4 and GTA 5.
paragraphs.cn: Ambrosia是地图中较为乡村化的区域，遍布工厂和炼油厂，并由一个控制当地的摩托车帮派主导。这个帮派似乎不同于在《GTA4》和《GTA5》中占据重要地位的Lost MC。

paragraphs.en: With a map as big as Rockstar is promising, GTA 6 may feel daunting to would-be explorers. However, Rockstar plans to use the game's story to take players around the map and show off the different areas. Of course, this won't cover every inch of the world, but it will demonstrate the strong contrast of more affluent parts of Leonida versus more "poor" areas.
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到Rockstar承诺的地图规模如此庞大，《GTA6》可能会让准备探索世界的玩家感到压力。不过，Rockstar计划通过游戏剧情带领玩家前往地图各处，展示不同区域的面貌。当然，剧情不会覆盖世界的每一寸土地，但会呈现莱昂尼达州富裕地区与更「贫困」地区之间的鲜明对比。

paragraphs.en: GTA has historically let players hop in a cab to freely fast travel through the world, but Red Dead Redemption 2 was a bit more restrictive. You could fast travel from town to town, but not any hyper specific points on the map. GTA 6 will allow you to hop in a ride share car and zip around town... however, ride sharing means just that: sharing. Players will be able to share rides with other passengers and have unique conversations.
paragraphs.cn: 过去的《GTA》一直允许玩家乘坐出租车，在世界各地自由快速移动，但《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的限制更多。玩家可以在城镇之间快速移动，却不能前往地图上极其具体的地点。《GTA6》将允许玩家乘坐网约车在城内快速穿行……不过，拼车就意味着要与他人共享车辆。玩家可以和其他乘客一起乘车，并与他们展开独特的对话。

paragraphs.en: If you don't want to make conversation with other passengers or sightsee, you can doomscroll on Snapmatic, the game's parody of Instagram.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你不想和其他乘客聊天，也不想欣赏沿途风景，还可以在Snapmatic上无休止地刷动态。Snapmatic是游戏对Instagram的戏仿。

paragraphs.en: Players won't be able to post on the app themselves, as Jason and Lucia are on the run and would risk danger by being overly active on social media.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家无法亲自在这个应用上发帖，因为Jason和Lucia正在逃亡，过于活跃地使用社交媒体会让他们陷入危险。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will feature a boatload of side activities; here are just some of them, as revealed in Game Informer's story:
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将提供大量支线活动。以下只是Game Informer报道中披露的其中一部分：

paragraphs.en: Fans will be able to see and interact with 170 different types of animals. This includes over 60 birds, over 30 land mammals, and a variety of fish and reptiles. The extended gameplay reveal in August confirmed that players will be able to pet dogs and if it's anything like Red Dead Redemption 2, this will presumably extend to other animals like cats.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家将能够观察并与170种不同动物互动，其中包括60多种鸟类、30多种陆生哺乳动物，以及各种鱼类和爬行动物。8月公布的加长版实机演示确认，玩家可以抚摸狗。如果游戏的设计与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》类似，这项互动或许也会扩展到猫等其他动物。

paragraphs.en: “Florida has a diverse animal ecosystem that we wanted to faithfully include across the different biomes in Leonida – urban and rural environs, aquatic life both inland and ocean, and the wetland habitats like the swamps and Everglades,” Rockstar vice president of dynamic art, Michael Kane, explained. “The animal art and population teams are incredibly passionate about delivering animals that are accurately researched and look visually correct in every respect, alongside the supporting movement and animation to bring them to life.”
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar动态美术副总裁Michael Kane解释道：「佛罗里达州拥有多样化的动物生态系统，我们希望将其如实呈现在莱昂尼达州的不同生物群系中，包括城市和乡村环境、内陆与海洋中的水生生物，以及沼泽和大沼泽地等湿地栖息地。动物美术和生态群落团队都非常重视这一点，他们进行了准确的资料研究，力求让动物在各个方面都符合视觉表现，同时通过配套的动作和动画赋予它们生命。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar confirmed that GTA 6 features different shark species, jellyfish, whales, turtles, and rays in the game's sea. They will have "distinct movement behavior" and can be encountered while scuba diving in the water.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar确认，《GTA6》的海洋中将出现不同种类的鲨鱼、水母、鲸鱼、海龟和鳐鱼。它们会拥有「独特的运动行为」，玩家潜水时可能会遇到这些动物。

paragraphs.en: One of the screenshots in Game Informer's story shows Jason approaching deer in the wild with a rifle strung over his back. It seems to suggest some form of hunting will return in the game. Hunting was a very small part of GTA 5 and a bit half-baked. The system returned in Red Dead Redemption 2 with significantly more depth.
paragraphs.cn: Game Informer报道中的一张截图显示，Jason背着步枪，正在接近野外的鹿。这似乎暗示某种形式的狩猎玩法将回归游戏。狩猎在《GTA5》中只是很小的一部分，完成度也不算高；到了《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中，这套系统回归并拥有了明显更丰富的深度。

paragraphs.en: Players will be able to track animals as they did in Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar also confirmed there will be rare animal types, but didn't reveal any.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家将能够像在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中那样追踪动物。Rockstar还确认游戏中会有稀有动物种类，但没有透露具体有哪些。

paragraphs.en: Robberies are a central part of the game and players will have a lot of choice in how they do that. Do they go as a duo? Do they go alone? Do they go loud? Do they go quiet? There are a lot of options, but your choices will determine the level of response you can get from the police.
paragraphs.cn: 抢劫是游戏的核心内容之一，玩家可以自由选择行动方式。是两人一起行动？还是独自出手？是大张旗鼓地强攻？还是悄无声息地潜入？玩家有很多选择，而这些选择将决定警方的应对规模。

paragraphs.en: Jason and Lucia can shake the cops together or split up, leaving one person to take the bulk of the heat. However, if either one of these protagonists gets overwhelmed by police, it's game over.
paragraphs.cn: Jason和Lucia可以一起甩掉警察，也可以分头行动，让其中一人独自承受大部分警方压力。不过，如果两名主角中的任何一人被警方彻底压制，游戏就会结束。

paragraphs.en: Higher end cars require special tools to steal and if successful, they may have trackers or security systems to create new obstacles for you. Players can use an app known as WAiNK to determine a car's resale value, security system, and the cost to make it your own personal vehicle. Should you want to off-load it, you'll have to take it to a fence.
paragraphs.cn: 高档车辆需要特殊工具才能盗走，而且即使成功，车辆也可能装有追踪器或安全系统，为玩家制造新的障碍。玩家可以使用一款名为WAiNK的应用，查看车辆的转售价值、安全系统，以及将其变成个人车辆所需的费用。如果你想把车出手，就必须将它带到销赃者那里。

paragraphs.en: The two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, may long for a romantic relationship together, but it is up to the player to determine whether or not they go beyond a platonic one. The player will be able to essentially court the two characters by taking them on dates, paying attention when they call or text you, and being chivalrous by opening doors or holding hands.
paragraphs.cn: 两名主角Jason和Lucia或许都渴望发展恋爱关系，但他们是否会超越柏拉图式关系，将由玩家决定。玩家可以通过带两人约会、认真回应他们的来电或短信，以及为他们开门、牵手等绅士行为，来与这两名角色培养感情。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's story will be ripe for multiple playthoughs. Rockstar confirmed that choices big and small with not only influence Jason and Lucia's relationship, but the story as a whole, encouraging players to play the game again to see alternative story threads.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的剧情将适合多周目游玩。Rockstar确认，无论大小选择都会影响Jason和Lucia的关系，也会影响整个故事，从而鼓励玩家重新游玩，体验不同的剧情发展。

paragraphs.en: “As the pressure for us on this project is huge, we dealt with that by doing our best to overdeliver," said Rockstar North co-studio head Aaron Garbut. "Normally you compromise scale for detail or detail for interaction, but with this project we went the other way - everything is dialed up – detail, scope, breadth, scale, interaction and density. I don't think we have ever created anything close to this before."
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Aaron Garbut说道：「这个项目给我们的压力非常大，因此我们的应对方式就是尽力做到超出预期。通常情况下，你必须在规模与细节之间，或细节与互动之间做出妥协，但这次项目恰恰相反——细节、范围、广度、规模、互动和密度，一切都被提升到了更高水平。我不认为我们过去创作过任何接近这种规模的作品。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has created a wide variety of NPCs that vary in height, weight, skin type, and more. Characters can get a tan, they can have moles, and even the sizes of their butts and chests will vary from person to person.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar打造了种类丰富的NPC，他们在身高、体重、肤质等方面各不相同。角色可以晒黑，也可以长痣，甚至连臀部和胸部的大小都会因人而异。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will feature a ton of clothing options, which players can acquire with their ill-gotten gains. NPCs will also be dressed differently based on where they are in the world. If they're in a more impoverished area, expect them to have dirtier or weathered clothing.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将提供大量服装选项，玩家可以用不义之财购买这些服装。NPC的穿着也会根据他们所在的区域而有所不同。如果他们身处较为贫困的地区，身上的衣服可能会更脏，也更显破旧。

paragraphs.en: “We’ve been able to really go hard on that with creating the biggest range of garments and accessories we’ve ever made – supported with rich, realistic materials,” Kane says. “That surfacing includes color, patterns and branding that are both area-appropriate, but also tied to context (states of dirt/weathering and fitment) for the characters themselves and their social situation and how they inhabit Leonida. Shoes, sneakers, and colorways that we know carry cultural weight as items – likewise watches, sunglasses, or hats.”
paragraphs.cn: Kane说道：「在这方面，我们确实投入了大量精力，打造出了迄今为止规模最大的服装与配饰种类，并为它们配上丰富、真实的材质。服装表面包含符合区域特色的颜色、图案和品牌元素，同时也会结合角色自身的情境，包括衣物的脏污、磨损和合身程度，以及他们的社会处境和在莱昂尼达州的生活方式。鞋子、运动鞋及其配色都具有我们所熟知的文化意义，手表、太阳镜和帽子也是如此。」
